How it works Charts AI Assistant Open studio

A simple route from rows to a result.

Work with your own data, or open any chart and change its example.

  1. Bring dataPaste a table or open a CSV, JSON, or spreadsheet. OpenCharts reads it in your browser.
  2. Choose a chartSee which chart types can read your columns, then shape the data and appearance in the studio.
  3. Take it with youSave it here, share a link, or export the HTML, CSS, JavaScript, image, or print view.

Need an agent? Connect one when you need it.

Local chart suggestions work without AI. For questions about your data, OpenCharts can connect to a signed-in MCP agent on your device.

  1. Add the MCP server to Codex with codex mcp add opencharts -- node /absolute/path/to/OpenCharts/tools/mcp-server.mjs. Use your actual project path.
  2. Ask the agent for opencharts_status. Copy its http://127.0.0.1:…/#mcp=… link into Connect agent.
  3. Send your question here, then ask the agent to process the pending OpenCharts request. Keep the agent session open.
